about.title: A local team for the great Silk Road
about.p1: ZiyaraTour is a Tashkent-based agency specialising in cultural, historical and pilgrimage travel across Uzbekistan. We combine deep local knowledge with modern comfort so you can focus on the journey.
about.p2: Our team includes licensed guides, drivers, and long-time partners in every city we visit. We are proud partners of the International Institute of Central Asian Studies.
